_doc: Element chart (docs/BALANCE.md, Type chart). strong = elements this one hits for strong_mult. The reverse direction takes weak_mult; every other pair is neutral. Dual defenders multiply. era = first era the element appears in; Era II elements sit only on legendary (ancient) Spirlings so far. Rust and Mask belong to the post-game region Vellmarch (data/region2.json); they enter the Elements enum with that region's own Spirlings. Acid and Frost belong to the Era III post-game region Quillmarch (data/region3.json) and enter the enum the same way. A pair that beats each other (Lumen and Umbra) is neutral both ways and counts as neither strength nor weakness. Checked by tools/balance/type_sim.py and tests/unit/test_type_chart.gd: every element has at least 2 real strengths and 2 real weaknesses, as many strengths as weaknesses (Era I alone and all eras), and no element strictly dominates another; the chart sim keeps every element at 40-60 % and every team of 3 at 30-70 %.
